lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Concept model A: similar triangles and slope

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Study both examples. The second one drops some of the wording of the first.

items.prompt: A line passes through (1, 2). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 3 and a vertical leg (rise) of 2. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 2 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?

steps: The base slope triangle shows a slope of 2/3.
Scaling the triangle by 2 gives a run of 6 and a rise of 4 from (1, 2).

items.prompt: A line has a slope of 3/4. A right triangle drawn along the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 12 units. What is the length of the vertical leg (rise)?

steps: Slope = rise/run, so rise = slope × run.
The vertical leg is 9 units long.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of a line with slope 4 and y-intercept 10.
Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line y = -4x - 6.

Relationship A (proportional):
x: 4, 8, 12
y: 5, 10, 15
Relationship B: y = 4x
By how much does the greater rate of change exceed the lesser rate of change?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: For the line y = -4x - 3, find y when x = 10.
A line has equation y = 4x - 13. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?
A line has equation y = x + 9. Write the equation of the line through (5, 6) that is parallel to this line.
A plant's height is given by H = 1w + 24, where H is the height in centimeters and w is the number of weeks since it was measured. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The plant was 24 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant grows 24 centimeters per week.
The plant grows 1 centimeters per week.
The plant was 1 centimeters tall when it was first measured.

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A moving company's total cost is given by C = 11h + 6, where C is the total cost in dollars and h is the number of hours of labor. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The company charges a flat fee of $6 before any labor hours.
The company charges $6 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges $11 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges a flat fee of $11 before any labor hours.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (-9, 9) and (6, 33).
